durable_learning: Persistence of information is not the same thing as persistence of operational understanding. Smart Notes are the compounding substrate: consequential experience becomes a canonical Note Event, human meaning, Naya understanding, and machine-operational memory; the event becomes visible to the Intelligent Feed and Daily Intelligence; and authorized downstream promotion can compound it further. A receipt is not decorative proof—it is part of the user-facing contract. The system must enforce the difference between documented law and guaranteed behavior, and it must never use conversational claims as a substitute for repository evidence.
